features.description: Required for the interaction with KIF5B and for anterograde transport in axons
Binding site for the uncoating ATPase, involved in lattice disassembly
Involved in spindle localization and interaction with TACC3
Involved in binding clathrin light chain
Important for nucleosome binding activity of the PRC2 complex
Required to release iHOPS from membranes
Required for interaction with histone H3 and histone H4
Required for recruitment to DNA damage sites and for interaction with the NuRD complex, CHD4, HDAC1, HDAC2 and KDM1A
